engine_source.source_conclusion: set_editor_property supports notify_mode; default builds property change notifications. set_editor_properties still sends one PostEditChange per object.

Expression notifications recompile the owning non-preview material. Base constructor supplies one unnamed output. Custom input access and ComponentMask compilation read current fields. Additional Custom outputs require RebuildOutputs.
Create/connect/delete only notify an open MaterialEditor. Explicit final RecompileMaterial posts final material change and returns compile errors.
GrassOutput input enumeration reads GrassTypes directly. Per-edit handler validates names/rebuilds a GUI node; source layer names are already nonempty and unique.
Final material change rebuilds cached expression analysis. Material already calls its scoped CancelOutstandingCompilation.
Scoped cancellation gathers the current compiling shader-map ID for each resource.
Cancellation removes pending jobs for selected map IDs and suppresses obsolete results; it does not interrupt a running compiler task.

required_result: actual phase progress and bounded native exit
